definition_of_end_date: 42 consecutive days of zero simulated incident confirmed cases (within 260-day model horizon).
caveat: The 260-day total is NOT a guaranteed final outbreak size. Rt scenarios are assumed, not forecasts of intervention effects. AI links first 28 days only; no clinical onset-date adjustments.

model_definitions.branching: Renewal/branching process with overdispersed counts and Rt reversion assumption
model_definitions.ai_linked: Validated LightGBM direct weekly incidence forecasts constrain days 1–28; stochastic branching renewal model continues after day 28
model_definitions.ai_improved: Same forecast, assumed Rt tends to 0.52
model_definitions.ai_delayed: Same forecast, assumed Rt tends to 0.96

short_term_ml_validation.evaluation: Time-forward LightGBM refits and independent branching forecasts; disjoint-week national MAE on matured labels. SitRep revisions and interpolation remain limitations.
